title: 星割りの塔
tagline: 一晩で現れた黒い塔から、リナの物語が始まる。
taglineEn: A black tower appears overnight, and Rina's story begins.

characters.name: リナ
characters.desc: 17, a map-maker's apprentice from Rieden village. Curious to a fault.
characters.register: Casual feminine-neutral speech: あたし, plain forms, sentence-final の/よ/ね, casual contractions (〜てる, 〜なきゃ).

characters.name: ガルドヴァン
characters.desc: The old mage who lives in the tower. Knows why it moved.
characters.register: Classic sage role language (博士語): わし for I, じゃ for だ, 〜ておる for 〜ている, 〜ねばならぬ, 〜まい, sentence-final のう/かの. Heard in fiction constantly, never in real life.

characters.name: ドレック
characters.desc: A mercenary hired for the road to the capital. Louder than he is dangerous.
characters.register: Rough masculine speech: 俺, だぜ/だろ, contractions 〜ちまう/〜じゃねえか, dropped politeness everywhere. The register of action heroes and street toughs.

characters.name: エステル
characters.desc: Second princess of the realm. Sharp behind the etiquette.
characters.register: Court keigo: 〜でございます, いらっしゃる/おっしゃる, humble いたす/おる, 〜ませ. The register of palaces, hotels, and formal business.
